shared_elements: frontal standing anthropomorphic figure carved on a tall upright slab
large head occupying the upper portion of the monument
headdress or headgear above the face
circular disc / pectoral ornament on the chest
arms bent across the front of the body
incised glyph-like or symbolic motifs on the headgear area
relief carving covering the whole face of an upright monolith
justification: Both depict a single frontal standing human figure filling the whole face of a tall upright slab, with an oversized head under a headdress in the upper third, arms folded at the chest, and a circular pectoral disc at the centre of the torso \u2014 a fairly specific and conventional scheme. The biggest difference in depicted content is density and elaboration: B swarms with subsidiary masks, plumed scrollwork, a held ceremonial bar and ornament chains rendered in deep, naturalistic modelling, while A is reduced to sparse, flat incised outlines with no attributes or subsidiary figures.
